offer.text: A spider nest has spilled out past the treeline and they hunt by night. Loose your arrows and clear out six before they reach the homes.

accept.text: Pick them off at range. Don't let them close.

decline.text: Then keep your shutters latched tonight.

in_progress.text: How many of the eight-legged horde have you felled?

ready.text: Six skewered and the rest scattered. Fine archery.

complete.text: You've a steady draw. The watch could use your bow again.
